A '''dropbox''' was a [[Color/Legends|gray]] flat control panel carried by the guards of the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. Each [[Prisoner/Legends|inmate]] of the prison had a [[subatomic electrostatic detonator]] implanted in the walls of his [[Heart/Legends|heart]]. By typing in an inmate's prison number using the device's keypad, a guard could activate those charges.<ref name="Lock" />
